messages.content: Please check whether my checking account is active. Then look up AAPL and BTC, and place a guarded buy order for 250 USD. After that, get the latest AAPL quote and archive that snapshot in my app as a high-priority archive titled “Daily Quote Archive” for user_123, then pull today’s business news. Next, find similar audio products to the Sony WH-1000XM5 in black in the audio category, choose one recommendation for me to review, and place an order for 1 black Sony WH-1000XM5 using product_id p_sony_xm5_blk, with items [{product_id: p_sony_xm5_blk, quantity: 1}] and order_quantity 1, using the best available discount and payment_method paypal. Finally, send me a high-priority alert through the app channel when everything is done.
